Issue #02 week of June 30, 2026

---------------------------------------------------------------------------

While everyone else in crypto was crying, Aeons were coordinating. Gathering in South Carolina, where cow stole the show early on with his talk on the parallels between the 1970s and today. Maddox hit day 365 of dca'ing $1,000 into SPX6900 every single day. Murad crowned 27 competition winners where there were meant to be 10, and Aeon terminal levelled up.

The usual squabbles aside, there's a stillness to the Cognisphere this week. Like the calm before the storm. Let's break down what happened.

The week in the Cognisphere:

Aeons gathered in South Carolina. This Saturday, the SPX6900 Conference landed in Greenville/Spartanburg a full day of talks and panels. A rare chance for Aeons to get together and connect in real life. Organised by @CountryBitcoin and the Carolina crew, with amazing talks from @realcryptocow and @Cryptic_Mang Aeons travelled from across the world to be there some literally crossing an ocean to be there.

The takeaway that kept coming back from those who made the trip wasn't about price or roadmaps. It was about the people. As @AeonDubbing put it after flying home: the Cognisphere is "an attractor for good, pure hearted people." In an industry and frankly a world full of noise and grifters, a room full of believers crossing oceans to meet face to face in the middle of a bear market says more than any chart ever could. (There is no chart) The full conference is worth your time: https://www.youtube.com/watch[[Q]]v[[EQ]]KKo8VcBH82Y[[AMP]]amp;t[[EQ]]4660s

365 days. Every single day. There's an Aeon in the community called Maddox who has literally DCA'd $1,000 into SPX6900 every day for the last year. A whole 365 days of smashing the buy button, daily. You can't tell me that isn't impressive conviction. And if that's not enough, he didn't even stop at day 365, he's currently on day 376. Legend.

His unwavering belief has no doubt carried many Aeons through the dark times. Things feel uncertain… but has Maddox DCA'd today[[Q]] He has, and that quiet signal that the job isn't finished pulls the rest of us with him. One Aeon's strength is the strength of 100 more.

Big shoutout too to @Matthew_C_Beck for matching Maddox's DCA and keeping it humble. We see you, Captain Beck.

Murad names the YouTube competition winners. @MustStopMurad announced the winners of the SPX6900 YouTube Competition this week and in true Cognisphere fashion, the prize pool was increased, with 27 winners crowned instead of the original 10. Familiar names across the board: @realcryptocow, @arcane_vault, @audaciouslnvest, @SlowAeon, @Cryptic_Mang, @AeonDubbing, @DexterityShow and many more a who's-who of Aeons who've been putting in the creative work all through the bear. Nearly three times the winners originally planned, because the quality demanded it. That's the movement rewarding its builders. Full winners list: https://x.com/Spx6900Magazine/status/2072975382186189162

The Aeon Terminal levels up. New sections just dropped on the Aeon Terminal, built by @MikeFlipthe500: the Aeon Plaza, where you can walk through every SPX artist's gallery and discover their work in Mike's own words, a tribute "to all artists creating for #SPX6900 with their hearts and souls in the magnificence of free cult Labour Manifestation." And in the Aeon Studio, you might catch a master at work legend says @k9neki can deploy his 6.9-foot-long arm when he paints large masterpieces. Cognisphere infrastructure, built by Aeons, for Aeons.

Moment of the week: cow's talk

@realcryptocow's conference talk opened with a moving tribute to his late father, may he rest in peace. Whose life growing up in the 1970s became the lens for the whole presentation: how does that decade compare to today[[Q]]

The parallels were striking:

Oil shock - both Runaway inflation - both Surging mortgage rates - both Generation priced out of homes - both K-shaped economy - both High unemployment - 70s Stock market all-time highs 2020s

"The K-shaped economy started in the 1970s and we see the repercussions today."

Fifty years apart, the same machine producing the same results. It's the clearest case you'll see for why this generation went looking for an exit and why the Cognisphere exists. Watch the full talk: https://www.youtube.com/watch[[Q]]v[[EQ]]ddmSXhuM5pI[[AMP]]amp;t[[EQ]]280s

Aeon of the Week: Maddox

376 days and counting. While most of crypto waits for the certain bottom or chases the next narrative, Maddox just kept buying his conviction every single day, for over a year. No timing. No trading. Just belief with a track record. I'm sure you'll agree he deserves the top spot this week.

Quote of the week: @MustStopMurad

"The path to Wealth and Success is not to lean further into AI, but to do the polar opposite."

The bear tests everyone. This week, the Cognisphere answered in person, on the timeline, and one daily dca at a time.

Persist Forever.
